evidence.observation: Flow dropped from ~100 sccm to ~55 sccm despite 100 sccm setpoint during growth
Pressure fell from 3.05 to ~2.58 Torr concurrently, consistent with a real flow loss
Cooldown flow tracks 200 sccm setpoint normally again
